plan: possession-v2.3 (position-noise robustness: input smoothing + wider training noise)
motivation: Reporting-only sensitivity of the v2.1 recipe on the four validation matches (copy 101): base 0.610; extra i.i.d. ball noise 0.5 m 0.537; extra i.i.d. PLAYER noise 0.5 m 0.495; slowly varying 1 m ball bias 0.519. v2.2 (wider ball noise in training only) gained +0.016 on ball-noisy copies, lost 0.005 on the original copies and missed its +0.010 gate. The provided ATD is automatic and uncorrected; its position error is unknown and may exceed the 0.3 m used in training.

candidate.preprocessing: NaN-aware centred moving average of every player and ball coordinate over 5 frames (+-2, 0.2 s) inside each play block, applied after corruption and before features, identically in training and inference; a missing frame stays missing (no gap filling)
candidate.training_profile: v2.3 = v2.2 ball ranges (ball noise 0.05-0.6 m, slowly varying ball bias 0-0.6 m) + player noise 0.03-0.6 m (was 0.03-0.3)
candidate.unchanged: features v2, stage-1/stage-2 hyper-parameters and stacking recipe, training matches and seeds, decoder family
candidate.decoder: re-selected for v2.3 on the 24 validation copies from the same 54-point grid

validation.V_ext_ball: 8 copies, seeds 301/302, v2.1 corruption + ball noise 0.3-0.6 m + ball bias 0.2-0.6 m
validation.V_ext_players: 8 copies, seeds 501/502, v2.1 corruption + player noise 0.3-0.6 m
validation.systems: frozen v2.1 recipe (4-match models, decoder 3/60/60/-0.3, no smoothing) vs v2.3 (4-match models, smoothing, own decoder) on the same 24 copies

select_v2_3_only_if_all: mean spellF1 over the 24 copies >= v2.1 on the same copies + 0.010
selection_rule.then: final bundle on 6 DFL matches with its own source freeze and run entry point (possession.run23); reserved Metrica game 3 test once (v2.1 corruption 201/202, extended ball 401/402, extended players 601/602) for v2.1 and v2.3

limits_stated_in_advance: The noise levels of V_ext_* are a physical prior, not measured on the provided match.
All validation copies come from the same four matches; v2.2 and the sensitivity checks were seen before this plan.
